title: DuckStation 0.1-10998: official stable release
summary: DuckStation published 0.1-10998 on April 3, 2026. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation emulator project.

blocks.text: The DuckStation project published version 0.1-10998 on April 3, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: c339e6727 Qt: Tweak slider colour in Dark Ocean theme. 28c34feeb Qt: Use saveAndReloadGameSettings() instead of manual save. efa974193 Qt: Warn when changing renderer for the first time. 0f7eed06c dep/imgui: Update to 3a26b64.
